_info: Checklist mapping for Aion 2 Global/EU, derived from capture 20261006-205450 (frames5.jsonl) + aion2.app quest DB. 'status': verified = seen in traffic and/or matches DB text; guessed = plausible, not confirmed. Achievement counters are cumulative per character: count today/this week = current counter - baseline stored at the first 0x8356 after the reset (or 0 if the record timestamp is older than the last reset).

daily.evidence: S2C 0x23E2 at login = u64 ms 2026-10-07 07:00Z (next daily reset); 0x56E2 group type 1 last=2026-10-06 07:00:01Z next=2026-10-07 07:00Z; 0x1C8D tail 2x u64 = next reset

protocol.0x8356: login snapshot per character: varint n + n x {u32 id, u32 counter, u64 ts_ms, u8 tier}. Arrives again on character switch -> reset overlay state.
protocol.0x1C8D: duty-mission board at login: u32 0, u32 5 (daily limit or remaining? guessed), varint n, n x {u32 slot, u32 quest_id, u32 journal_ref, u32 0, u8 state (1=offered, 4=accepted), u8 n_rewards, n_rewards x 15 B}, tail 2 x u64 next reset
protocol.0x098D: quest journal at login: varint n, n x {u32 quest_id, u8 state (2=active, 3=partial, 4=objectives done), u8 step, u8[6] objective counts, u32 journal_ref, u64 0, u8 n_rewards, n_rewards x 15 B}
protocol.0x8E56: limit counters with reset time: u16 0, varint n, n x {u32 id, u32 value, u64 next_reset_ms}. Seen once (21:25:08) after some UI action, ids 1169=4,1172=0,1209=4,1210=16,1211=7 (daily/weekly), 1254=0 (never), 1262=1 (monthly)
protocol.0x56E2: reset-group table: n x {u32 group, u8 type (1 daily, 2 weekly, 3/4 season), u64 last_reset, u64 next_reset, u8 n, entries {u32 group, u32 entry_id 201xxxx, u32 count}}; all counts 0 in capture - meaning unknown (missions/pass?)

duty_quest.how: achievement 'Pflicht-Quests: Missionen' counter via 0x8356/0x8456, delta since daily reset; board/accepted quests via 0x1C8D, progress via 0x098D

emergency_supply.how: achievement 'Versorgungsgesuche: Notfall' counter delta since daily reset

weekly_supply.how: achievement 'Versorgungsgesuche: Woechentlich' counter delta since weekly reset

pve_pvp_weekly_quests.how: achievement 'Pflicht-Quests: Schriftrollen' counter delta since weekly reset; split PvE/PvP only via 0x098D quest ids
